title: Bleeding in THA implantation depending on intraoperative blood pressure
summary: The implantation of a total hip arthroplasty (THA) comes along with a relevant intraoperative blood loss. However, this blood loss can vary greatly from patient to patient. Subjectively, the impression was obtained that the amount of blood loss is related to the intraoperative blood pressure of the patient. This will be found out in this study.

interventions.name: all patients with primary osteoarthritis of the hip

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
osteoarthritis of the hip
Exclusion criteria:
taking anticoagulants, disorders of blood clotting, tumor disease, pre-surgery, deformities such as hip dysplasia, preoperative irradiation
